socialism-and-modern-science-darwin-spen: Enrico Ferri wrote Socialism and Modern Science. Robert Rives La Monte turned the book into English. The third edition came out at Chicago in 1917. Charles H. Kerr and Company printed it. The work rests on a 1900 copyright. The contents open with a preface and a first part. That part treats three claimed clashes between Darwinism and socialism. It names Virchow and Haeckel at the Munich congress. It then takes up the equality of persons. The struggle for life and the survival of the fittest follow.
